verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents organization-scoped HTTP webhook destinations that you set up once and attach to monitoring rules. That gives a programmatic consumer outbound HTTP callbacks, but only for SQL-based alert rules firing, not a general event-subscription system. Missing for 10: webhooks for broader event types (cluster lifecycle, batch job progress/completion, schema deploys), documented payload format and signing/retry semantics, programmatic (API/MCP) webhook registration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
